note: Page-level decisions from data-collection's agent visual check (2026-11-18; an agent check, not human review). Committed before the run that applies them. 'legacy' = kraken's legacy box segmenter (nlbin + pageseg.segment, Apache-2.0, no recognition) replaces blla on that page, because blla found no or almost no lines on a page with visible text and legacy found them. 'no_hebrew_text' = the page shows no Hebrew handwriting (blank or ruled leaf, flyleaf, cover, or a near-blank microfilm frame); its boxes are kept as segmented, and eval decides whether the page stays in the set. 'poor' = boxes are known to be poor on this page.
